final_answer:
Yes. Two of the five PPQ batches, PPQ26-02 and PPQ26-03, had a critical process parameter outside its PPQ acceptance range. Only one of them has a deviation, and that deviation covers a different failure.

**What I checked.** PPQ-001 has five CPP criteria. For the five PPQ batches (PPQ26-01 to -05) I compared each CPP with its range:

| CPP (range) | Result |
|---|---|
| Seeding density (0.4–0.6 ×10⁶/mL) | All batches within range (0.47–0.54). |
| Activation to transduction (20–30 h) | All batches within range (21.9–23.7 h). |
| Culture duration (7–9 days) | All batches harvested on day 8. |
| MOI (4–6 TU/cell) | The MOI target was 5.0 for every batch. Using the vector lot titer, the MOI works out to about 5.0 each time, so all are within range. |
| Incubator temperature during expansion (36.5–37.5 °C) | Out of range for PPQ26-02 and PPQ26-03. PPQ26-01, -04 and -05 stayed within range. |

**The temperature excursion.**
- Incubator INC-03 (tag `INC03.TEMP.PV`) fell below 36.5 °C from 2026-06-10 22:00 to 2026-06-11 08:00. The low was 33.53 °C, about 10 hours below range.
- INC-03 logged a door-open alarm (ALM-DOOR) at 21:40 and a low-temperature alarm (ALM-TEMP-LO) at 22:22. OP-04 acknowledged both at 07:50 the next morning.
- Both PPQ26-02 and PPQ26-03 were in INC-03 for their expansion phase, so both were exposed.

**Was a deviation raised?**
- **PPQ26-02: yes, DEV-26-033.**
  - It is a MAJOR protocol deviation, opened 2026-06-12 and now closed.
  - It was raised for harvest viability of 75.2%, below the 80% criterion. The root cause is that the operator did not confirm the door latch, and the INC-03 door was found not fully latched.
  - It is linked to CAPA-26-015 (operator retraining on the door-latch check), which is closed.
  - The deviation text does not mention the temperature CPP excursion. Its impact assessment says only that criterion 6 (harvest viability) was missed.
- **PPQ26-03: no.**
  - I found no deviation or trace link for this batch, and no deviation mentions the INC-03 excursion in relation to it.
  - The batch itself looks fine: harvest viability was 93.8%. The excursion hit it roughly 1.5 days after activation, soon after transduction.
  - The CPP excursion is still unreported and should be raised, or at least assessed under DEV-26-033.

**Other points.**
- I assumed PPQ26-03 was still in INC-03 at the time of the excursion. Its expansion samples are logged against INC-03 from day 3, but I have no record of where it sat on days 0–2.
- A few BAD-quality (null) tag readings exist on INC03 and INC04. They are sensor data gaps, not out-of-range values, so I did not count them.
- The other PPQ deviations, DEV-26-038 (label printer) and DEV-26-041 (tubing leak), are not CPP excursions.
